accounting: Nonrefundable admission envelopes, not a subscription debit formula. Sum input + cache creation + output across unique modelUsage entries including web helpers; exclude cache reads. Actual overrun blocks the slot. No retry borrows the reviewer reservation.
validation: Existing schema, citation, causal source, URL, universe, reviewer and execution validations unchanged. Never accept partial or repaired model output.
scope: AM and PM base/news plus probes. Separate daily slot and arm pools. No role/call budget expansion, retired GPT reactivation, grant edit, store rebinding or retrospective migration.
